messages.send.title: Send Message
messages.send.description: Send a text message to a Telegram chat via the bot.

chatId.description: Target Telegram chat ID (or @channelusername) to send the message to.

text.description: Message text to send. Maximum 4096 characters.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the sent message.

channelId.description: Chat ID the message was delivered to.

text.description: Text of the sent message as returned by Telegram.

messages.sendPhoto.title: Send Photo
messages.sendPhoto.description: Send a photo to a Telegram chat. Accepts a file_id, URL, or local file path for the photo.

chatId.description: Target Telegram chat ID (or @channelusername).

photo.description: Photo to send. Pass a file_id, a URL, or a local file path.

caption.description: Optional caption for the photo, 0-1024 characters.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the sent photo message.

channelId.description: Chat ID the photo was delivered to.

caption.description: Caption of the photo as returned by Telegram.

messages.sendDocument.title: Send Document
messages.sendDocument.description: Send a document (file) to a Telegram chat. Accepts a file_id or URL.

chatId.description: Target Telegram chat ID (or @channelusername).

document.description: Document to send. Pass a file_id or a URL.

caption.description: Optional caption for the document, 0-1024 characters.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the sent document message.

channelId.description: Chat ID the document was delivered to.

caption.description: Caption of the document as returned by Telegram.

messages.edit.title: Edit Message
messages.edit.description: Edit the text of an existing message sent by the bot in a Telegram chat.

chatId.description: Chat ID containing the message to edit.

messageId.description: Identifier of the message to edit.

text.description: New text for the message. Maximum 4096 characters.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the edited message.

channelId.description: Chat ID of the edited message.

messages.delete.title: Delete Message
messages.delete.description: Delete a message from a Telegram chat. The bot must have appropriate admin privileges.

chatId.description: Chat ID containing the message to delete.

messageId.description: Identifier of the message to delete.

deleted.description: Whether the message was successfully deleted.

messages.forward.title: Forward Message
messages.forward.description: Forward a message from one Telegram chat to another chat.

chatId.description: Target chat ID to forward the message to.

fromChatId.description: Source chat ID where the original message lives.

messageId.description: Identifier of the message to forward.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the forwarded message in the target chat.

channelId.description: Chat ID the message was forwarded to.

messages.pin.title: Pin Chat Message
messages.pin.description: Pin a message in a Telegram chat. The bot must have appropriate admin privileges.

chatId.description: Chat ID containing the message to pin.

messageId.description: Identifier of the message to pin.

disableNotification.description: If true, sends the pin notification silently.

pinned.description: Whether the message was successfully pinned.

chats.get.title: Get Chat
chats.get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a Telegram chat (group, supergroup, or channel) by its chat ID.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat (or @channelusername for public channels).

chats.getMemberCount.title: Get Chat Member Count
chats.getMemberCount.description: Get the number of members in a Telegram chat or channel.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat (or @channelusername for public channels).

count.description: Number of members in the chat.

chatId.description: Chat ID the count belongs to.

chats.sendAction.title: Send Chat Action
chats.sendAction.description: Send a chat action (e.g. 'typing', 'upload_photo') to a Telegram chat to indicate activity to the user.

chatId.description: Target chat ID (or @channelusername).

action.description: Type of action to broadcast. One of: typing, upload_photo, record_video, upload_video, record_voice, upload_voice, upload_document, choose_sticker, find_location, record_video_note, upload_video_note.

ok.description: Whether the chat action was sent successfully.

bot.getMe.title: Get Bot Info
bot.getMe.description: Retrieve information about the bot itself using the configured bot token. Returns the bot's user profile.

bot.description: Bot user profile as returned by Telegram.

messages.sendLocation.title: Send Location
messages.sendLocation.description: Send a map location to a Telegram chat using the Bot API, including optional live-location updates.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target channel.

heading.description: For live locations, direction of travel in degrees (1-360).

livePeriod.description: Period in seconds for which the location will be updated (60-86400).

horizontalAccuracy.description: Radius of uncertainty for the location in meters (0-1500).

proximityAlertRadius.description: Maximum distance in meters for live-location proximity alerts (1-100000).

replyMarkup.description: Inline keyboard, reply keyboard, or JSON-serialized markup object.

replyToMessageId.description: If the message is a reply, ID of the original message.

disableNotification.description: If true, sends the location silently.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the sent location message.

channelId.description: Chat ID the location was delivered to.

messages.sendPoll.title: Send Poll
messages.sendPoll.description: Send a native regular or quiz poll to a Telegram chat using the Bot API.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target channel.

options.description: Answer options, 2-10 strings of 1-100 characters each.

type.description: Poll type. One of: regular, quiz.

isClosed.description: If true, the poll is sent already closed.

closeDate.description: Unix timestamp when the poll will automatically close. Cannot be used with openPeriod.

explanation.description: Text shown when a user picks a wrong quiz answer, 0-200 characters.

openPeriod.description: Seconds the poll stays open (5-600). Cannot be used with closeDate.

isAnonymous.description: If true, the poll is anonymous. Defaults to true on Telegram.

replyMarkup.description: Inline keyboard, reply keyboard, or JSON-serialized markup object.

correctOptionId.description: 0-based index of the correct quiz option. Required when type is quiz.

replyToMessageId.description: If the message is a reply, ID of the original message.

disableNotification.description: If true, sends the poll silently.

explanationParseMode.description: Parse mode for the quiz explanation. One of: Markdown, MarkdownV2, HTML.

allowsMultipleAnswers.description: If true, the poll allows multiple answers. Ignored for quiz polls.

providerMessageId.description: Telegram message ID of the sent poll.

channelId.description: Chat ID the poll was delivered to.

chats.exportInviteLink.title: Export Chat Invite Link
chats.exportInviteLink.description: Generate a new primary invite link for a chat. Any previously generated primary link is revoked. Maps to Telegram exportChatInviteLink.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup or channel.

inviteLink.description: Primary invite link returned by Telegram.

chatId.description: Chat ID the invite link belongs to.

chats.getAdministrators.title: Get Chat Administrators
chats.getAdministrators.description: Get administrators in a chat. Returns ChatMember objects for administrators except other bots. The bot must be a member of the chat.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup or channel.

administrators.description: ChatMember objects for administrators visible to the bot.

chatId.description: Chat ID the administrators belong to.

chats.getMember.title: Get Chat Member
chats.getMember.description: Get a chat member's status and permissions, including the bot itself, to preflight access before sending or moderating.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup or channel.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the target user.

chatId.description: Chat ID the member lookup was performed against.

chats.getHistory.title: Get Chat History
chats.getHistory.description: Get recent messages for a chat by polling getUpdates and filtering to the requested chat_id. Requires no active webhook. The bot can only see messages from after it joined.

chatId.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup or channel.

limit.description: Maximum number of updates to retrieve from getUpdates (1-100). Defaults to 100.

offset.description: getUpdates offset. Negative values retrieve from the end of the pending queue.

messageId.description: If set, only messages with this ID or later are returned.

messages.description: Messages from the requested chat extracted from getUpdates.

chatId.description: Chat ID used to filter history.

bot.getUpdates.title: Get Updates
bot.getUpdates.description: Receive incoming updates using long polling. Does not work while a webhook is configured; delete the webhook first or Telegram returns HTTP 409.

offset.description: Identifier of the first update to return. Must be one greater than the highest previously received update_id to confirm earlier updates.

limit.description: Maximum number of updates to retrieve (1-100). Defaults to 100.

timeout.description: Long-polling timeout in seconds (0-50). Defaults to 0 (short polling).

allowedUpdates.description: Update types to receive. An empty list receives all types except chat_member.

bot.setMyCommands.title: Set Bot Commands
bot.setMyCommands.description: Change the list of the bot's commands shown in Telegram clients. At most 100 commands can be set.

commands.description: Bot commands to set. Each item needs command (1-32 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores) and description (1-256 characters).

command.description: Command text without the leading slash.

description.description: Description shown next to the command.

scope.description: BotCommandScope object or JSON-serialized scope. Omitting it sets the global default list.

languageCode.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code. Empty applies to all users in the given scope without a dedicated language list.

ok.description: Whether Telegram accepted the command list.

callbacks.answer.title: Answer Callback Query
callbacks.answer.description: Send an answer to a callback query from an inline keyboard. The answer is shown as a notification or an alert.

callbackQueryId.description: Unique identifier for the callback query to answer. Must be answered promptly.

text.description: Notification text shown to the user, 0-200 characters. Omitted means no notification text.

showAlert.description: If true, the client shows an alert instead of a top-of-chat notification.

url.description: URL opened by the user's client. Game URLs require a callback_game button.

cacheTime.description: Maximum time in seconds the callback result may be cached client-side. Defaults to 0.

ok.description: Whether Telegram accepted the callback answer.

credentials.validate.title: Validate Credentials
credentials.validate.description: Validate the configured Telegram credentials against the provider. Takes no input and reports whether the credentials are accepted.

valid.description: Whether the configured credentials are valid.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Telegram connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.
